user.title: waipu.tv login
user.description: Username and password of your waipu.tv account. Two-factor authentication is not supported.

tv_setup.title: Choose your TV
tv_setup.description: Which TV should be controlled? On Android TV the integration switches channels directly and plays recordings; on Apple TV it can only open the waipu app. Can be changed any time later via 'Configure'.

android_tv.title: Android TV
android_tv.description: The remote entity from the official Android TV Remote integration (androidtv_remote).

data_description.waipu_app_link: Opens the app without a specific channel. Only change this if you use a different waipu variant (e.g. o2 TV).
data_description.cast_entity: Lets the integration notice channel switches made on the TV itself or in the waipu app: the TV reports the running program's title over Google Cast, and the integration looks up the matching channel among your channels.

apple_tv.title: Apple TV
apple_tv.description: The media_player entity from the Apple TV integration. No channel links are known for tvOS — the integration can only open the waipu app there.

data_description.waipu_bundle_id: Only change this if you use a different waipu variant (e.g. o2 TV).

error.invalid_auth: Login failed — please verify your credentials.

init.title: waipu.tv options
init.description: TV and channel selection. The TV's own settings follow on the next page; with 'All channels', the channel list after that.

data_description.android_tv_channel_view: Favorites: follows your waipu favorites live. All channels: you pick the channels on a separate page.
data_description.reminder_notify: One or more notify targets (e.g. the companion app). Empty = no push messages; switching still happens.

android_tv.title: Android TV
android_tv.description: The remote entity from the official Android TV Remote integration (androidtv_remote).

data_description.waipu_app_link: Opens the app without a specific channel. Only change this if you use a different waipu variant (e.g. o2 TV).
data_description.cast_entity: Lets the integration notice channel switches made on the TV itself or in the waipu app: the TV reports the running program's title over Google Cast, and the integration looks up the matching channel among your channels.

apple_tv.title: Apple TV
apple_tv.description: The media_player entity from the Apple TV integration. No channel links are known for tvOS — the integration can only open the waipu app there.

data_description.waipu_bundle_id: Only change this if you use a different waipu variant (e.g. o2 TV).

channels.title: Visible channels
channels.description: Channels that become HA entities and appear in the player's channel list.

stop_recording.name: Stop recording
stop_recording.description: Stops an active recording early, keeping what's been captured so far.

delete_recording.name: Delete recording
delete_recording.description: Delete one or more cloud recordings.

create_serial_recording.name: Start serial recording
create_serial_recording.description: Records every future episode of the series, not just the given program.

play_recording_on_android_tv.name: Play recording on Android TV
play_recording_on_android_tv.description: Opens a cloud recording on the Android TV: resume, from the start, or just its detail page.

open_program_on_android_tv.name: Open program on Android TV
open_program_on_android_tv.description: Opens a program's detail page on the Android TV, or plays it.

restart_program.name: Restart program
restart_program.description: Jumps back to the start of the live program on the Android TV (restart).

add_reminder.name: Remind and switch
add_reminder.description: Sends a push a few minutes before and switches the TV to the channel at the start — for one program, every episode of a series or on a schedule.

program_id.name: Program ID
program_id.description: For a program: the program_id from the now/next sensors. Leave empty for a schedule.

series.name: Series
series.description: With program_id: remind of every episode of this series on the channel.

days.name: Weekdays
days.description: For a schedule. Empty = every day.

once.name: Once
once.description: Schedule only the next time, then switched off.

switch.name: Switch at start
switch.description: Off = only remind, the TV stays where it is.

update_reminder.name: Change reminder
update_reminder.description: Switches a reminder on or off, changes switching or skips the next time.

reminder_id.name: Reminder ID
reminder_id.description: The id from the reminders attribute of the Reminders sensor.

skip_next.name: Skip next time
skip_next.description: On = no push and no switch next time; off = back to normal.

reminder_id.name: Reminder ID
reminder_id.description: The id from the reminders attribute of the Reminders sensor.

missing_configured_entity.title: {field} not found: {entity_id}
missing_configured_entity.description: The {field} entity `{entity_id}` set under Configure no longer exists in Home Assistant — was it renamed, removed, or does it belong to a removed integration? The affected services/entities won't work until this is fixed. Open the integration's options and reselect the correct entity (or remove the pairing if you no longer want it).
